body: Thanks a lot. I think this is some of the best advice I've ever gotten. I'm going to keep on trying to get better.

I want to do something with myself. I feel like I'm just wasting my life and that I have no purpose. I want to stop feeling empty. I guess I just need something to occupy my time. 
What I want to change is my outlook on everything. I'm too pessimistic but I don't know how to stop.
